objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Find the Mutillidae page that runs an operating system command with your input, use it to run a command on the web server, and read /ctf/flag.
hints: Look in the OWASP 2017 menu under Injection: one page looks up a host name for you.
At security level 0 the page passes the host name straight to a shell command. Which vulnerability class is that?

steps.title: Find the page
steps.prompt: Which Mutillidae page resolves a host name by running a system tool? (its file name)

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which form parameter carries the host name to the command?

steps.title: Name the flaw
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets your input run a command of your own on the server?
